LESSON: READING 1.2.1 INDEPENDENT READING - GRADE APPROPRIATE TEXT

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.2: Reading 1.2.1 Independent Reading - Grade Appropriate Text

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading 1.2.1 Independent Reading - Grade Appropriate Text. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is it important to read different types of materials?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read grade appropriate materials for lifelong learning
2. create a reading log for monitoring reading activities

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: READING 1.2.1 INDEPENDENT READING - GRADE APPROPRIATE TEXT
This lesson teaches Reading 1.2.1 Independent Reading - Grade Appropriate Text for Grade 9 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. read grade appropriate materials for lifelong learning
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. create a reading log for monitoring reading activities
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading 1.2.1 Independent Reading - Grade Appropriate Text using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading 1.2.1 Independent Reading - Grade Appropriate Text above.
2. Explain Reading 1.2.1 Independent Reading - Grade Appropriate Text to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading 1.2.1 Independent Reading - Grade Appropriate Text.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 1.2.1 Independent Reading - Grade Appropriate Text with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 1.2.1 Independent Reading - Grade Appropriate Text important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it important to read different types of materials?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. read grade appropriate materials for lifelong learning
2. create a reading log for monitoring reading activities

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
